title: Insights on Disagreement Patterns in Multimodal Safety Perception across Diverse Rater Groups

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating perceived harmfulness of text-to-image generations related to gender by collecting ratings on a 5-point scale from a demographically diverse pool of 630 raters, and analyzing annotator disagreement and group cohesion compared to expert safety ratings.
